title: Cloudflare OS: every user gets their own private app instance
description:
Cloudflare OS gives every user a private copy of each app rather than one shared SaaS instance, so a slide deck is a sandboxed program you can ask an agent to modify. Rather than stalling on every permission prompt, a Gatekeeper simulates the outcome and feeds the agent simulated results, letting it queue work you approve in bulk later. Running it off Cloudflare on workerd is marked coming soon. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-os
